q: How does a Satna cement plant count diesel and blasting at its limestone mine?
title: Satna limestone mines: diesel and blasting
short: If the plant owns or runs the mine, diesel for drills, shovels and dumpers is Scope 1 at about 2.68 kg CO2 per litre. Explosives also release CO2 when they detonate, a small amount per tonne of rock. Report the mine with the plant, but as its own line.
audience: Cement plants in Satna and Maihar with captive limestone mines

ul: Diesel issued to mine equipment, from fuel logs or invoices.
Explosives used, in kg, by type.
Limestone mined and sent to the crusher, in tonnes.

p: If a contractor runs the mine and buys its own diesel, it is Scope 3 for you, unless you supply the fuel. Check the contract.
Mining is small next to calcination and kiln fuel, but auditors check that it is there.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and freight invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record per site, so each figure you send a buyer traces back to the documents behind it.
